name: Lucilla

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Glacio Rectifier Hybrid with dual 'Resonance Mode' identity (Glacio Chafe or Echo Skill) chosen based on team; buffs whichever mode via her Outro and Ultimate (Clear As Day -> Reminiscence). Only 5 inputs needed for a full rotation, one of the easiest Hybrids in the game.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack (3 hits, Focus Ring timing minigame on Stage 3 for bonus Trace).
skills.resonanceSkill: Phantom Frame - pull + Glacio DMG, Focus Ring timing gives Compensate (unremarkable) or Spotlight (better, CD reduction/Concerto).
skills.forte: Memory Palace - governs Trace (max 150) -> Photo (max 3) generation and consumption, plus Film Roll (Chafe mode) / Zoom (Echo mode) stacks.
skills.liberation: Clear As Day - no Energy cost (0 max Energy), unlocks at 3 Photos; enters Reminiscence stance (Tracing Forms Basic Attack combo ending in Letting It Go AoE).
skills.intro: Clip It - Glacio hit + 1 Glacio Chafe stack, restores 100 Trace.
skills.outro: Montage - +60% Glacio Chafe DMG (Chafe mode, 30s) or +50% Echo Skill DMG to next character (Echo mode, 14s).

bestWeapons: Lethean Elegy (93.1/99%, best Echo-mode alt, Phrolova sig)
echoSet: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall (100%, Chafe mode)
Moonlit Clouds (100%, Echo mode, with Impermanence Heron)
Dream of the Lost (special - Phrolova team, 3-piece + 2-piece of choice, gives Lucilla 20% CRIT Rate/35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus)
substatPriority: ATK = Basic DMG% (Basic DMG near-useless in Echo mode, prioritize ATK)

teams.name: Glacio Chafe Team
teams.notes: Hiyuki is Lucilla's only and best Chafe-mode partner.

teams.name: Echo Skill Hypercarry
teams.notes: Sigrika is the best Echo-DMG dealer to pair with Lucilla; Galbrena and Phrolova are viable alternates.

rotation: Intro -> Skill: Spotlight (perfect release) -> Ultimate -> Heavy: Basic - Forms 1,2,3 -> Letting It Go -> Outro. Release the Skill hold roughly a quarter-second in for a perfect Spotlight.
communityNotes: Prydwen: best pick for Glacio Chafe and one of the best for Echo DMG, two of the strongest archetypes in the game; extremely low input-count rotation with no Energy requirements, but her animations restrict quickswap and (like all Rectifier characters) she lacks good non-signature permanent weapon alternatives.
